title: Scaling up Test-Time Compute with Latent Reasoning: A Recurrent Depth Approach
authors_zh: Jonas Geiping、Sean McLeish、Neel Jain、John Kirchenbauer、Siddharth Singh、Brian R. Bartoldson、Bhavya Kailkhura、Abhinav Bhatele、Tom Goldstein（机构：ELLIS Institute Tübingen、马普智能系统研究所、马里兰大学、劳伦斯利弗莫尔国家实验室等）
paper_type_zh: 测试时计算扩展架构研究（NeurIPS 2025）
best_for_zh: 研究隐空间推理、循环网络与非文字化测试时扩展的读者。
one_line: A depth-recurrent language model scales inference compute by iterating hidden-state reasoning rather than producing longer visible chains.
该研究以隐空间循环深度替代更长文字思维链，使模型通过更多内部迭代扩展测试时计算。
why: It treats recurrent depth as an explicit test-time budget independent of visible chain-of-thought length.
inclusion_reason: It directly varies inference computation through recurrent latent depth and measures the resulting reasoning behavior.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Most test-time reasoning methods buy additional computation by asking a model to emit more visible tokens. This makes every intermediate operation occupy context, requires long-chain behavior to be learned from specialized data, and couples the reasoning budget to a verbal trace that may be redundant or unable to express the useful internal computation. It also makes a longer answer an imperfect proxy for a deeper computation.

This work asks whether a language model can spend additional inference compute internally, before producing the next word. The decision object is the number of recurrent latent iterations applied to a hidden state for a prompt and token position. Instead of selecting a longer chain or more candidates, the system selects recurrent depth. The paper studies whether such depth can improve reasoning and coding performance while retaining small context windows and standard language-model training data.

多数测试时推理方法通过要求模型输出更多可见 token 来购买额外计算。这会让每个中间操作占用上下文，需要从专门数据学习长链行为，并把推理预算绑定到可能冗余、或无法表达有用内部计算的文字轨迹上。因此，更长的回答只是更深计算的不完美代理。

本工作研究语言模型能否在生成下一个词之前，于内部花费额外推理计算。决策对象是对一个提示和 token 位置的隐藏状态施加多少次循环潜变量迭代。系统不再选择更长链条或更多候选，而是选择循环深度。论文检验这种深度能否在保持小上下文窗口和标准语言模型训练数据的同时改善推理和代码任务表现。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The model inserts a recurrent block into a transformer-style language architecture and repeatedly applies it to the hidden representation. At test time, this block can be unrolled to different depths, so the same model receives different amounts of internal processing without first producing an extended chain of thought. The recurrence makes compute a continuous architectural control rather than a count of displayed reasoning tokens.

The paper argues that latent iterations can represent operations that are hard or wasteful to verbalize. Its reported architecture also supports zero-shot per-token adaptive compute, KV-cache sharing, and speculative decoding, which connect recurrent depth to serving cost as well as accuracy. The central record is therefore not a curated trace but an inference execution: prompt, chosen recurrent depth, hidden-state evolution, generated output, and task outcome.

模型在变换器式语言架构中插入循环模块，并反复将其应用于隐藏表示。测试时，该模块可以展开到不同深度，因此同一模型在不先输出延长思维链的情况下获得不同量的内部处理。循环使计算成为连续的架构控制量，而非展示出的推理 token 数。

论文认为，潜变量迭代能够表示难以或不值得文字化的操作。其报告的架构还支持零样本逐 token 自适应计算、键值缓存共享和推测解码，将循环深度同时连接到服务成本与准确率。核心记录因而不是筛选后的轨迹，而是一段推理执行：提示、选择的循环深度、隐藏状态演化、生成输出和任务结果。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors train a depth-recurrent language model from scratch. A recurrent block iteratively updates the latent state, and inference can allocate more or fewer iterations before a token is emitted. This differs from prompting an unchanged autoregressive model: the architecture and training recipe must teach the recurrent dynamics to remain stable and useful over variable unroll lengths. The paper reports a proof-of-concept model with 3.5B parameters trained on 800B tokens.

At evaluation, the number of latent iterations is varied as the test-time budget. The study measures reasoning and coding tasks as well as language-model behavior, and compares performance at different internal compute levels; the abstract reports loads equivalent to as much as 50B parameters. The official repository provides pretraining and inference code, and links a Hugging Face model. Reproduction should record recurrent-depth schedule, per-token depth, cache behavior, tokens, latency, memory, output, and benchmark score, because visible output length cannot reveal how much latent computation was used.

作者从头训练深度循环语言模型。循环模块迭代更新潜变量状态，推理可在输出一个 token 前分配更多或更少迭代。这不同于给不变的自回归模型追加提示：架构与训练配方必须让循环动力学在不同展开长度下保持稳定和有用。论文报告一个 3.5B 参数、在 800B token 上训练的概念验证模型。

评估时，潜变量迭代数作为测试时预算变化。研究测量推理、代码和语言模型行为，并在不同内部计算等级比较性能；摘要报告最高达到相当于 50B 参数的计算负载。官方仓库提供预训练和推理代码，并链接 Hugging Face 模型。复现应记录循环深度日程、逐 token 深度、缓存行为、token、延迟、内存、输出和基准分数，因为可见输出长度无法揭示实际使用了多少潜变量计算。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper's evidence begins with scale and capability: it trains a 3.5B-parameter model on 800B tokens, then increases recurrent depth at inference rather than changing model weights. The reported result is that performance improves with additional compute, especially on mathematical and coding reasoning tasks, demonstrating that the model can use varying internal budgets rather than being fixed to its training-time depth.

The abstract reports that the model can reach a computation load equivalent to 50B parameters and describes some reasoning gains as dramatic. It also presents zero-shot per-token adaptive compute, KV-cache sharing, and speculative decoding as ways to reduce the cost of this approach. The result supports a distinct latent-compute scaling mechanism, but it remains evidence for the reported proof-of-concept architecture and benchmarks; it does not show that an ordinary pretrained transformer can obtain the same effect by simply looping its existing layers.

论文的证据从规模和能力开始：它在 800B token 上训练 3.5B 参数模型，随后在推理阶段增加循环深度，而不改变模型权重。报告的结果是，性能会随额外计算改善，尤其在数学和代码推理任务上，说明模型能够使用不同内部预算，而不是被固定在训练时深度。

摘要报告模型可达到相当于 50B 参数的计算负载，并将一些推理收益描述为显著。论文还提出零样本逐 token 自适应计算、键值缓存共享和推测解码，以降低这种方法的成本。结果支持一种不同的潜变量计算扩展机制，但它仍是对所报告概念验证架构和基准的证据；它并未说明普通预训练变换器只需循环现有层就能获得相同效果。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest token-based approaches scale a reasoning model by emitting or sampling more textual intermediate work. This paper changes the computational surface itself: the additional work is hidden-state recurrence, and recurrent depth can be increased before output generation. Consequently, an inference budget is not tied to chain-of-thought length or to a separate verifier, candidate selector, or specialized rationale dataset.

The reusable novelty is the explicit separation between visible language and internal iterative computation. Adaptive depth, cache sharing, and speculative decoding further make the depth schedule a serving decision rather than only an architecture diagram. The paper does not claim that latent states are intrinsically interpretable or that all reasoning should be hidden; its contribution is a trained model design in which additional internal iterations can be measured and allocated independently of the displayed answer.

最接近的基于 token 方法通过输出或采样更多文字中间工作来扩展推理模型。本文改变了计算表面本身：额外工作是隐藏状态循环，并且可在输出生成前增加循环深度。因此，推理预算不再绑定思维链长度，也不依赖单独验证器、候选选择器或专门理由数据集。

可复用的新意是明确分离可见语言与内部迭代计算。自适应深度、缓存共享和推测解码进一步使深度日程成为服务决策，而不只是架构图。论文并未声称潜变量状态天然可解释，或所有推理都应隐藏；其贡献是训练出一种模型设计，使额外内部迭代可独立于展示答案被测量和分配。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method requires a depth-recurrent model trained for variable unroll lengths, so it cannot be applied as a prompt-only retrofit to most deployed transformers. Sequential recurrence can raise latency even when context use is lower, and the recurrent-depth budget is less transparent to users than a visible reasoning trace. The paper reports a 3.5B proof of concept; transfer to larger models, different data mixtures, or tool-using systems needs direct evaluation rather than extrapolation from parameter-equivalent compute alone.
该方法需要为可变展开长度训练的深度循环模型，因而无法作为仅提示的改装方案应用于大多数已部署变换器。顺序循环即使降低上下文使用，也可能提高延迟；循环深度预算对用户而言也比可见推理轨迹更不透明。论文报告的是 3.5B 概念验证，能否迁移到更大模型、不同数据混合或工具使用系统，必须直接评估，不能只根据参数等价计算外推。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when the system owner controls model architecture and wants a test-time budget that is not forced through longer textual rationales. A production evaluation should log prompt class, recurrent iterations per token, total recurrent operations, generated tokens, cache reuse, speculative-decoding behavior, latency, memory, energy if available, and task result. Compare models at matched wall-clock and quality targets, because a parameter-equivalent compute statement does not replace deployment measurements.
当系统所有者能够控制模型架构，并希望测试时预算不必通过更长文字理由来消耗时，本论文很有用。生产评估应记录提示类别、每个 token 的循环迭代、总循环操作、生成 token、缓存复用、推测解码行为、延迟、内存、可获得时的能耗和任务结果。应在匹配实际运行时间和质量目标下比较模型，因为参数等价计算的说法不能代替部署测量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the training architecture and the inference accounting together. The central claim is not merely that a recurrent network can improve accuracy, but that a model trained with recurrent depth can use more internal compute at test time. Check which improvements persist when depth, output length, and wall-clock cost are all reported. Then inspect adaptive-depth and cache results separately from base scaling curves, because they address serving efficiency after the architecture has already established the latent-reasoning capability.
应把训练架构与推理成本统计一起阅读。核心主张不只是循环网络可提高准确率，而是用循环深度训练的模型能在测试时使用更多内部计算。检查当深度、输出长度和实际运行时间都被报告时，哪些改善仍然成立；再将自适应深度和缓存结果与基础扩展曲线分开阅读，因为前者是在架构已经建立潜变量推理能力后解决服务效率的问题。
